sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 29 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SPY、CXMT、MU、MSFT、PE。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • The FOMC decision will be released today at 14:00 ET, followed by Warsh’s first high-pressure press conference at 14:30. Economists broadly expect rates to remain unchanged at 3.50%–3.75%, marking the fifth consecutive hold, but an unusual split has emerged among voting members—Dallas Fed President Logan has publicly argued that rates should be “moderately higher.” Warsh has pledged to reduce forward guidance and told Congress this month that he has “zero tolerance for persistently high inflation.” Broad markets weakened across the board while awaiting the decision: SPY 734.78 (-0.81%, intraday low 733.82), QQQ 667.31 (-1.20%, with its low of 665.94 landing exactly on the community’s much-discussed “666”), DIA 518.62 (-1.56%), and IWM 289.47 (-1.34%).
  • South Korea’s KOSPI triggered a circuit breaker for the second consecutive trading day, with trading halted for 20 minutes at 12:32 after the decline exceeded 8%. The index plunged nearly 13% at one point, falling below 5300, losing more than 18% over two days and more than 30% in July, putting it on track for its worst month on record. This is the first time the KOSPI has triggered circuit breakers on two consecutive days.
  • The shockwave from the listing of China’s CXMT (ChangXin Memory Technologies) continues to reverberate. The company debuted on the STAR Market of the Shanghai Stock Exchange on July 27 at an offering price of RMB 8.66, raising approximately RMB 57.9 billion (about $8.6 billion), and surged as much as 471% intraday on its first day. Combined with news that China has begun producing domestic lithography equipment and reports that “Apple is testing CXMT chips,” the global memory supply chain continued to collapse: MU 782.83 (-4.59%, opening at 832, spiking to 841, then plunging to 776), SNDK 1029.66 (-6.03%, falling below 1005 intraday), SOXL 97.25 (-11.19%), ARM 230.68 (-5.81%), AMD 430.43 (-5.30%), and INTC 83.35 (-3.35%).
  • The Nasdaq 100 opened 10% below its June high of 30,660, officially entering a technical correction. The AI infrastructure chain was hit particularly hard: VRT missed second-quarter revenue expectations and fell to 234.07 (-13.13%); NBIS dropped to 152.20 (-10.33%); and CRWV fell to 62.19 (-7.59%). On the industrial side, CAT sank to 789.86 (-6.15%) amid two consecutive rating downgrades and pre-earnings risk reduction ahead of its 8/4 report.
  • Renewed tensions in the Middle East pushed oil prices higher. Iran launched a “surprise” ballistic missile attack against U.S. military bases in the Middle East, but all missiles were intercepted. Trump said he was inclined to avoid further escalation. Today’s EIA inventory report showed a surprisingly large drawdown—approximately -7 million barrels by the community’s count, versus expectations for a modest build. The SPR has fallen to 311.4 million barrels, its lowest level since March 1983. USO 128.97 (+7.06%) was one of the day’s strongest themes.
  • MSFT and META report earnings tonight, representing the week’s largest single risk event. MSFT 394.76 (+0.33%), GOOGL 334.36 (+0.17%), and AAPL 340.04 (flat) were among the few names holding up as nearly the entire market turned red.

社区氛围：极度悲观、高度麻木——情绪从愤怒的抱怨转变为自嘲投降。 “V 形复苏”已经被多次提及，以至于它已经失去了所有意义，每根绿色蜡烛都自动被认为是牛市陷阱。与此同时，一小群人正试图在联邦公开市场委员会 (FOMC) 会议之前抓住底部，押注“所有坏消息都已被消化”。总体而言，社区处于情绪崩溃和赌博成瘾相结合的混乱状态。

恐惧/贪婪等级：恐惧8.5/10。 VIX刚刚突破20，但实际个股波动幅度远大于指数层面波动——社区反复指出“指数层面的平静与个股的血腥屠杀完全脱节”。多名用户要求置顶自杀热线，而号码也确实被发布了。大量民意调查显示，年初至今损失为 -15%/-40%/-70%，而报告的累计损失从之前分析中的六位数上升到一名用户报告的 -900,000 美元。与此同时，残余的贪婪依然明显：MU 5-10 倍的远期市盈率被反复引用为“逢低买入的理由”，而 DCA 人群继续增持头寸。

WSB 情绪与实际价格走势：社区的说法已变成“人工智能泡沫正在破裂”、“1929 年的剧本”和“30 年的熊市”，尽管 SPY 仅比历史最高点低 4% 左右。每当提及这一事实时，都会遭到讽刺的抵制：“我们可以禁止那些说 SPY 仅占 ATH 的 x% 的人吗？”现实是一种极端的结构性分歧：半导体、内存和人工智能基础设施正在崩溃，而 SaaS (ADBE +5.52%)、消费必需品和一些大型科技股 (MSFT/GOOGL/AAPL) 实际上正在吸引资本。社区的绝望程度是由其头寸结构（大量投资半导体和杠杆 ETF）驱动的，而不是指数本身。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心观点总结
